name: AppTrove
description:
Apptrove MCP connects Claude to your Apptrove MMP account with read-only access. Ask about installs, revenue, partners, in-app events, retention, UniLinks, and fraud  Claude calls the same analytics APIs your dashboard uses.

Connect with OAuth and paste your Apptrove API key. Tools inherit that key’s org type (advertiser, agency, or partner), user role, and app access.

Preferred tools for counts:
• connection-info / app-list — who you are and which apps you can access
• today-summary / daily-report / multi-app-daily-report — install and revenue totals
• partner-breakdown / event-breakdown — partner and event funnels
• unilink-report — UniLink template performance
• dashboard-stats / cohort-report / customer-report — dashboard-style reports

Log tools (Install-log, event-inapp-logs, etc.) return paginated samples for inspection only  not aggregate counts.

This connector does not create, update, or delete data. Access matches your Apptrove API key permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AppTrove to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AppTrove to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.apptrove.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AppTrove MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AppTrove lists 47 MCP tools, including Install-log, active-agency-list, activity-report, agency, all-apps-summary, app-list, app-setting-details, branded-domain-list, branded-domain-verify, click-log, cohort-report, and configuration-api.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AppTrove?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AppTrove in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
AppTrove requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AppTrove is developed by Apptrove. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
